{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "91b7766e-27d7-4466-a64c-7600ee6d9c8f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Example-63: AT interface"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "bcc761a4-8f42-459a-a9be-6b18c9bbed70",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# In this example, lattice conversion to AT is demonstrated\n",
    "# Twiss parameters are compared for the resulting lattice\n",
    "# Note, AT dipoles do not have curviliner sextupole component, model dipoles should be set to linear for the result to match"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "b8acf925-4374-4104-859d-f0343011f45e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Import\n",
    "\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "from torch import Tensor\n",
    "\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from tqdm import tqdm\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib\n",
    "from matplotlib import pyplot as plt\n",
    "from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle\n",
    "matplotlib.rcParams['text.usetex'] = True\n",
    "\n",
    "from model.library.element import Element\n",
    "from model.library.line import Line\n",
    "from model.library.corrector import Corrector\n",
    "from model.library.quadrupole import Quadrupole\n",
    "from model.library.matrix import Matrix\n",
    "\n",
    "from model.command.external import load_lattice\n",
    "from model.command.build import build\n",
    "from model.command.tune import tune\n",
    "from model.command.tune import chromaticity\n",
    "from model.command.orbit import dispersion\n",
    "from model.command.orbit import ORM\n",
    "from model.command.twiss import twiss\n",
    "from model.command.advance import advance\n",
    "from model.command.coupling import coupling\n",
    "\n",
    "import at\n",
    "from model.interface.at import convert"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "f8b40a4d-6a7b-4481-8834-43c142cfeb24",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Set data type and device\n",
    "\n",
    "Element.dtype = dtype = torch.float64\n",
    "Element.device = device = torch.device('cpu')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "a1c5645c-f0b7-493c-a9c2-7e554491149f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Load lattice (ELEGANT table)\n",
    "# Note, lattice is allowed to have repeated elements\n",
    "\n",
    "path = Path('elettra.lte')\n",
    "data = load_lattice(path)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "c623f3d0-55e3-47f4-9d3b-6e30d424cb5d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "{'BPM': 168,\n",
       " 'Drift': 744,\n",
       " 'Dipole': 156,\n",
       " 'Sextupole': 240,\n",
       " 'Quadrupole': 120,\n",
       " 'Corrector': 24,\n",
       " 'Marker': 24}"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Build and setup lattice\n",
    "\n",
    "ring:Line = build('RING', 'ELEGANT', data)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Flatten sublines\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.flatten()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove all marker elements but the ones starting with MLL (long straight section centers)\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.remove_group(pattern=r'^(?!MSS_)(?!MLL_).*', kinds=['Marker'])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Set sextupole integration order and step size\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.order = (('Sextupole', 1), )\n",
    "ring.ns = (('Sextupole', 0.01), )\n",
    "\n",
    "# Set linear dipoles\n",
    "\n",
    "def apply(element:Element) -> None:\n",
    "    element.linear = True\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.apply(apply, kinds=['Dipole'])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Insert correctors\n",
    "\n",
    "for name, *_ in ring.layout():\n",
    "    if name.startswith('CH'):\n",
    "        corrector = Corrector(f'{name}_CXY', factor=1)\n",
    "        ring.split((1 + 1, None, [name], None), paste=[corrector])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Merge drifts\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.merge()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Change lattice start start\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.start = \"BPM_S01_01\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Split BPMs\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.split((None, ['BPM'], None, None))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Roll lattice\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.roll(1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Splice\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.splice()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Describe\n",
    "\n",
    "ring.describe"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "00f81e89-e7e5-4eec-80b6-7fc217b2cb53",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Compute tunes (fractional part)\n",
    "\n",
    "nux, nuy = tune(ring, [], matched=True, limit=1)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "b12a83bc-e554-4e1b-8918-83ca07ca3352",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Compute dispersion\n",
    "\n",
    "orbit = torch.tensor(4*[0.0], dtype=dtype, device=device)\n",
    "etaqx, etapx, etaqy, etapy = dispersion(ring, orbit, [], limit=1)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "148f1355-9761-47a4-b7b2-53bb727c94c9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Compute twiss parameters\n",
    "\n",
    "ax, bx, ay, by = twiss(ring, [], matched=True, advance=True, full=False).T"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "fec1f6eb-4d54-4088-bbd7-97565e05619d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Compute phase advances\n",
    "\n",
    "mux, muy = advance(ring, [], alignment=False, matched=True).T"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "35d5f8c3-8243-445e-9d10-4004b1ced1b9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Compute coupling\n",
    "\n",
    "c = coupling(ring, [])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "911a4ba7-e3bf-426c-9a1a-76b9092a5df1",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Compute chromaticity\n",
    "\n",
    "psi = chromaticity(ring, [], matched=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "8274d3c9-29f3-48b2-a038-c3018555e42e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Generate AT lattice\n",
    "\n",
    "lattice = convert(ring, energy=2.4, alignment=False)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "85d08a4f-1e8f-46ca-b426-8c7813b9fda7",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "168\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compute optics\n",
    "\n",
    "refpts = lattice.uint32_refpts(at.Monitor)\n",
    "print(len(refpts))\n",
    "_, ringdata, elemdata = lattice.get_optics(refpts=refpts, get_chrom=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "3c38590a-7e3d-495e-9d7b-7ee2e68bb962",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Set optics at BPMs\n",
    "\n",
    "nux_at, nuy_at = ringdata['tune']\n",
    "psi_at = ringdata['chromaticity']\n",
    "\n",
    "ax_at, ay_at = elemdata['alpha'].T\n",
    "bx_at, by_at = elemdata['beta'].T\n",
    "mux_at, muy_at = elemdata['mu'].T\n",
    "etaqx_at, etapx_at, etaqy_at, etapy_at = elemdata['dispersion'].T"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "77b530b3-3239-4d5f-961d-d26248e95a0c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "0.2994188531997346 0.160819239377483\n",
      "0.29936925627927957 0.16081887953270443\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compare tunes\n",
    "\n",
    "print(nux.numpy(), nuy.numpy())\n",
    "print(nux_at, nuy_at)\n",
    "print()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "ed8aa73f-4ce7-4728-8cc6-e0ca5f1c55c3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[2.02960315 2.01312355]\n",
      "[2.02925217 2.01315103]\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compare chromaticities\n",
    "\n",
    "print(psi.numpy())\n",
    "print(psi_at)\n",
    "print()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "20b1e771-fc3e-4d3c-8d53-33d50df5ad2d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [

     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},

    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compare beta functions\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))\n",
    "plt.errorbar(ring.locations().cpu().numpy(), bx, marker='x', color='blue')\n",
    "plt.errorbar(ring.locations().cpu().numpy(), bx_at, marker='o', color='red', markerfacecolor='none', ms=8)\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))\n",
    "plt.errorbar(ring.locations().cpu().numpy(), by, marker='x', color='blue')\n",
    "plt.errorbar(ring.locations().cpu().numpy(), by_at, marker='o', color='red', markerfacecolor='none', ms=8)\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "id": "7f060162-222b-4da1-a6f1-8ad0852cfef8",

      ]
     },

    },
    {
     "data": {

       "<Figure size 800x400 with 1 Axes>"

   ],
   "source": [
    "# Compare dispersion functions\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))\n",
    "plt.errorbar(ring.locations().cpu().numpy(), etaqx, marker='x', color='blue')\n",
    "plt.errorbar(ring.locations().cpu().numpy(), etaqx_at, marker='o', color='red', markerfacecolor='none', ms=8)\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
